findings.claim: J(x)=D0^2/(8pi^2)(log(x^2/eps)+gamma_E-3log2)+o(1)
findings.method: direct x-space quadrature (two-centre (r,s) reduction, mpmath dps 20), |x|=1, eps=1e-3..1e-5 (7 values); free fit a log eps+b+c eps log eps+d eps(+eps^2 terms)
findings.comment: difference to the claimed asymptotics is -6 eps + O(eps^2 log eps) (smaller than the allowed O(eps log eps)); 6-parameter fit reproduces the constant to 2e-8.

findings.claim: R(x)=D0/(16pi^2)(log(x^2/eps)+1+gamma_E-3log2)+o(1)
findings.method: as R1, also at dps 26 (identical to 18 digits)
findings.comment: difference is -4 eps + O(eps^2 log eps).

findings.method: radial momentum quadrature and, independently, the x-space form int d^4w D_1(w)[D_2(w)-D_1(w)]
findings.comment: agreement to 21 digits.

findings.claim: Lemma lem:local (i): LHS -> D0[R + D0 c_loc]
findings.method: exact reduction LHS-D0R = Term1 + Term2 (heat semigroup K*D_eps = D_2eps; harmonic multipoles l=1,2 of D0 around x, Hobson identity), 2d quadratures, eps=1e-2..1e-5
findings.comment: Term1 equals D0^2 c_loc up to exponentially small terms (mean-value property of the harmonic D0); the remainder Term2 ~ -0.02 eps log eps -> 0 (2.4e-6 relative to 2.6e-3 at eps=1e-5). Terms l>=3 of the multipole series are neglected (O(eps^3 log eps)).

findings.claim: Lemma lem:local (ii): LHS -> J + 2 D0^2 c_loc
findings.method: LHS-J = <P,(K*P)-P>, P=D(x-z)D(z), symmetric half-space reduction + multipoles l<=2 + heat semigroup; eps=1e-2..1e-5
findings.comment: difference behaves like eps log^2 eps (-4.4e-6 at eps=1e-5) -> 0.

findings.claim: G1: singular parts of the scalar self-energy graphs = ch04 table (2, 5/2, -1/4, -2 for eps^-1; 0, 0, 1, -2 for log eps)
findings.method: own Feynman rules: vertex functions by polarisation of -S_E (su(2), su(3)), seagull contractions, 10d chiral trace; singular parts from the direct momentum integrals (free fit); conversion Sigma=-2e g^2N/16pi^2 derived from eq:c4-pw (factor 2) and (X,Y)=-(4hbar/g^2)tr
findings.comment: all eight singular coefficients agree; total -9/(2 eps) + 2 p^2 log eps = table 9/4, -1.

findings.claim: sign and normalisation of the gaugino loop (Majorana-Weyl factor 1/2 x tr_16)
findings.method: tr_16(G^I G^K G^J G^L)=-16 d^IJ d^KL with explicit 32x32 gammas; supersymmetry test: with an identical cutoff on every loop momentum the quadratic divergences must cancel
findings.comment: seagulls -9, bubble +1, gaugino +8: sum 0 -> sign and factor 1/2 confirmed independently of Euclidean Majorana conventions.

findings.claim: M[0,0,2]=1-gamma_E-log2-log(eps p^2) (bubble master)
findings.method: one-dimensional position-space Hankel transform of D_eps^2, mpmath quadosc, eps=1e-2..1e-6
findings.comment: difference = 7.5 eps + O(eps^2) exactly; the constant is confirmed (refit const within 1e-9).

findings.claim: Sigma_ren(p) = (g^2N/16pi^2) p^2 (2 log p^2 + 2gamma_E + 2log2 - 43/8)
findings.method: referee reduction Sigma/(g^2N) = -9 T - 2 p^2 B + 9 C with C exact, plus direct numerical momentum integrals of bubble and gaugino at 8 eps (1e-4..2e-2) and free 7-parameter fit
findings.comment: analytic: 9C = 9/(32pi^2 eps) - 27 p^2/(128 pi^2) + O(eps), -2 p^2 b = p^2(2 log(eps p^2)+2g+2log2-2) -> -2-27/8 = -43/8. Numeric agreement 2e-8.

findings.claim: Prop prop:selfenergy per-graph finite constants: bubble +167/72, gaugino -13/9 (with the -2/+4 (log(eps p^2)+g+log2) terms)
findings.method: direct numerical momentum integrals (R9)
findings.comment: The per-graph constants printed in the proposition are wrong: numerically the bubble constant is 13/8 (=117/72) and the gaugino constant -7, matching the referee reduction (bubble = 2p^2B + C, gaugino = 4(2C - p^2B)). The printed ones sum to 7/8, not to the stated total -43/8 (the -13/9 is only the -8*13/72 part from M[1,1,4]; the 16 M[0,0,3] part -50/9 is missing; 167/72 exceeds 13/8 by 25/36). The total -43/8, which is all the theorem uses, is correct.

findings.claim: Lemma lem:fourier: FT of log q^2, log^2 q^2, 1/q^2, log q^2/q^2 at x != 0
findings.method: 4d Hankel transform with exponential (Abel) damping e^{-eta q}, Neville extrapolation eta->0, |x|=1,2,3
findings.comment: agreement to 1e-9..1e-11 at |x|=3, 7e-7..2e-10 at |x|=2; at |x|=1 the extrapolation is less converged (rel. 2e-5..2e-7, consistent with the scatter of the one-point-less extrapolant). The |x| dependence (log x^2 terms) is confirmed by the three radii.

findings.claim: ch05 thm:c5-Oeps / prop:c5-table: (e) unit log eps [2O - 2(a,b)K], (f) unit log eps [2O]
findings.method: own vertex functions (polarisation of -S_E), explicit su(2), su(3), random complex a,b; least-squares projection on O_ab and (a,b)K over many external legs; log coefficient -(1/16pi^2)
findings.comment: agreement to machine precision; colour factor scales as N (no 1/N).

findings.claim: EX and QU vertex, colour, flavour and symmetry factors: EX/tree = -g^2N x [(k+kp).(2q-k-kp) integral]/D0^2 ; QU/tree = -g^2N (2T-S)/S x J/D0^2
findings.method: symmetrised vertex functions of O and -S_E contracted with explicit |Aut| (tree 2, EX 2, QU 4), random momenta and flavour vectors, su(2), su(3)
findings.comment: confirms the two labelled exchange graphs give S12 with colour N dim g and relative factor -g^2N; the quartic factor 2T-S and symmetry factor.

findings.claim: thm:result: c_S = 27/2 + 4 log(3/2) - 8 beta_2, c_T = 8(gamma_E - 3log2), d_T = 8; per class values
findings.method: assembled from the referee-computed J, R constants, c_loc, Sigma_ren constant (numeric) and the Fourier entries, with the class formulas checked in R13/R6/R12

log_eps_coefficients.note: EX log eps coefficient = 4 a_J - 8 a_R = 4 ; QU: (2tau-1)*4 a_J = -(2tau-1)*4 ; OC: -8(1-tau) (G2) ; sum 0

findings.comment: per-class SE, EX, QU constants and log eps cancellation reproduced; beta_2 enters as -8 beta_2 (two lines x -4 beta_2 unit, plane-wave value of int(dA,dA) = 2|p|^2 (A(p),A(-p)) per eq:c4-pw); d_T = 8 from QU log x^2 (8 tau) consistent with the Konishi value 3g^2N/(4pi^2).

findings.claim: Prop prop:ip0: Gram_tree has eigenvalues (4hbar dim g/16pi^4) x {1 (twenty times), 2 (once, on K/sqrt6)} in the basis e_I e_J
findings.method: explicit 21x21 matrix S12 in the basis O_{e_I e_J}, I<=J
findings.comment: In the basis e_I e_J the matrix is diagonal with 2 on the six O_{e_I e_I} and 1 on the fifteen O_{e_I e_J}, I<J (the proof itself says so); the eigenvalues are {1 x15, 2 x6}. K/sqrt6 has norm 2 but so do the five orthonormalised traceless diagonal combinations. Positivity, Hermiticity and the orthogonality of K to the 20-prime (also checked) are unaffected.

findings.claim: 2q^2 x (five-line graph) is a contact term at x != 0
findings.method: analytic review: no 2-edge cycles, triangle subgraphs and the whole graph are UV convergent (degree -2), so F5_eps(q) = q^-2 f(eps q^2), f(y) = 6 zeta(3)/(16pi^2)^2 + O(y log^k y); lemma fourier (last statement) then gives O(eps log^2 eps) at x != 0
findings.comment: Not computed numerically; the argument is sound and only needs the remainder bound of [tp, lem:t-ft], which I could not read.

findings.claim: Prop prop:herm (Hermiticity of the reflection form)
findings.method: line-by-line check against ch08 def:c8-Theta, thm:c8-fields (ii),(iii), def:c8-2pt
findings.comment: Each step follows from thm:c8-fields (ii) (W^Theta = W(J^Theta) for even J-prime = J + t1 a^Theta + t2 b), Theta^2 = 1, F^Theta(0) = F(0)^c and the order reversal of c. Gap: the two-point function uses the renormalised O(eps) = O - d_delta I^CT(O); reflection compatibility of the OPERATOR counterterms (d_delta I^CT(O^Theta) = d_delta I^CT(O)^Theta) is needed and is not among the stated hypotheses (it follows by the uniqueness/reality argument of thm:c8-fields (iii), but should be stated). The graded symmetry used is [tp, lem:t-elem (iii)], not readable by me.

findings.claim: Thm thm:hermrad (Hermiticity of the one-loop radial form)
findings.method: line-by-line check against ch08 def:c8-radial, prop:c8-C, def:c8-inner
findings.value_found: conclusion follows under its hypotheses; one justification is incorrect as written
findings.comment: The claim that the formal exponential e^{s delta^hbar} "terminates on each component of fixed weight" is not correct: the classical part of P_n - K_n acts on operators at x != 0 as a first-order differential operator mixing all derivative orders (finite conformal flow), so the series in s does not terminate. The needed identity <e^{-s delta}F, G> = <F, e^{s delta}G> follows instead from d/ds <e^{-s delta}F, e^{s delta}G> = 0 using the infinitesimal Ward identity on the flowed observables, PROVIDED the flow exists on renormalised observables and keeps the supports disjoint for s in [0, pi/4] (true classically by prop:c8-C). The Ward identity itself is [tp, thm:t-ward] (H1-H4), and the vanishing of Lambda^(0)-exact two-point functions is [tp, cor:t-exact]; neither could be read by me.

findings.claim: Prop prop:ip0: radial Gram matrix = minimal-scheme two-point coefficient at unit separation
findings.method: consistency with ch08 def:c8-inner and def:c8-radial
findings.value_found: consistent only if the frame P_1 = 0 is reached through the arity-one finite counterterm theta_P = -1/3 (which does not enter the arity-zero two-point function), not through a finite part psi of the operators
findings.comment: def:c8-radial gives P_1(O) = -(1/3 + theta_P) units on the scalar bilinears; if instead P_1 = 0 were imposed by the finite part psi' = (a_P/2){S(Delta),-}, the two-point coefficient would change (remark: a finite part m adds 2m), and in a scheme with P_1 = a_P{S(P_b),-} def:c8-inner multiplies by 1 - 2 a_P w. The proposition defers to [ip, prop:ip-frames (a)] and [ip, thm:ip-origin], which I could not read; this step is unverified.

findings.claim: spec section 1: "int dvol (A,A) -> (A(p),A(-p)) (ch04 eq:c4-pw)"
findings.method: comparison with ch04 eq:c4-pw
findings.comment: The spec misquotes eq:c4-pw by a factor 2; the theory note uses a compensating kernel convention, and its final conversions (Sigma_sing = -2e g^2N/16pi^2, Sigma_F = -4 beta_2 unit p^2) agree with the referee derivation from eq:c4-pw. No effect on results, but the convention should be stated once.

findings.claim: steps resting on documents outside the referee scope
findings.method: listing
findings.value_found: [tp, lem:t-ft] remainder estimate; [tp, lem:t-elem (iii)]; [tp, thm:t-ward], [tp, cor:t-exact]; [ip, lem:ip-W], [ip, thm:ip-origin], [ip, prop:ip-frames (a)]; ch06 thm:c6-dil values of D_1 (consistent with the remark c6-konishi and with d_T = 8)
findings.comment: Not verified (not in the allowed reading list). The numerical consequences that could be tested (Fourier remainder via B, J, R convergence) behave as claimed.

verdict.summary: Theorem thm:result (c_S = 27/2 + 4 log(3/2) - 8 beta_2, c_T = 8(gamma_E - 3 log 2), d_T = 8, per-class values, no log eps) is CONFIRMED by an independent third method on every recomputed ingredient: J, R, c_loc, Lemma local (i) and (ii), B master, Sigma_ren constant -43/8, G1, G2, Fourier entries, EX/QU combinatorics, fermion-loop sign. No fatal or major error found. Minor errors: (1) the per-graph finite constants of the bubble (167/72) and gaugino (-13/9) in prop:selfenergy are wrong (correct: 13/8 and -7; the printed ones do not sum to the stated total); (2) the eigenvalue statement for Gram_tree in prop:ip0 is wrong ({1 x15, 2 x6} in the basis e_I e_J); (3) thm:hermrad justifies the finite flow by a false termination claim (repairable by an ODE argument); (4) prop:herm should list the reflection compatibility of the operator counterterms; (5) steps resting on [tp], [ip] and the P_1 = 0 frame were not verifiable.
